custom_expected:
1. With the panel hidden, the pop-up no longer keeps clear of the space the panel used to take up. It sits against the edge of the browser window with a normal margin instead.
2. The whole pop-up is on screen: nothing is cut off at an edge, pushed outside the window, or left floating with a large empty gap beside it.
3. The pop-up behaves normally otherwise - you can read it, use its buttons, and close it.

Run this test as written and mark it on what you actually find. When it was last checked, on 11 August 2026, the Schedule toolbar had no panel button at all - the button furthest to the left above the grid was Today - so on that build steps 1 to 8 cannot be carried out and this test FAILS. Mark it failed if that is still what you see. If the button is there and behaves as described, mark it passed.

custom_steps:
1. With the left panel still showing, open something that pops open over the page - for example click a shift in the grid to open its details window.
2. Note where it sits on the screen, then close it.
3. Click the panel button above the grid, to the left of Today, to hide the left panel.
4. Open the same pop-up again.
5. Look at where it sits on the screen now.
